reader.edition-search: grep of Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior over FunctionValueLane.cs, IntrinsicCarrierRules.cs, IntrinsicRenderer.cs, NumericRenderer.cs, FunctionDeviceText.cs, CobolTable.cs and the runtime Median bodies: the only hit (IntrinsicCarrierRules.RoundsStandardArgument, DialectBehavior.IntegerArgumentRoundedUnderStandardArithmetic) concerns integer arguments under STANDARD arithmetic, absent at 85; lane choice and the Median bodies are edition-free

reader.notes: Witness g85_bf40_03 matches its golden at --std 85. The odd branch returns the middle argument whole (CobolIntrinsics.ExactValue Median returns xs[order[n/2]] after a stable algebraic sort; MedianScaled and MedianWide return it exactly at scale+1). Probes across ODO, multi-level ALL, usages, scaling, extremes and a self-referencing receiver all give the RV1 value.

refuter.evidence: Read A.2.25 whole plus A.2.2 (argument types, ALL expansion, ODO range) and A.2.3 (numeric function characteristics implementor-defined) in specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md. Read CobolIntrinsics.ExactValue.cs#Median (stable algebraic sort, odd count returns xs[order[n/2]] whole) and IntrinsicCarrierRules#SelectionNeedsExactLane (a list mixing a binary64 approximation with fixed-point items goes to the exact lane so the selected argument keeps its own content). Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-249/runs: r1-002 ODDR MEDIAN(0.1 SQRT(4) 0.3)=.300000 (fixed content kept beside a binary64), ODDA MEDIAN(0.3 SQRT(.01) .05)=.100000, T18O MEDIAN(BIG T1 T2) with S9(18) and SV9(18)=.000000000000000002 exactly, BG5 5-arg duplicates of +-max=999999999999999999, NEST MEDIAN(MEDIAN(1 2) 3 MEDIAN(1..6))=3, PSCO P-scaled SPPP9/S9P(3)/7 -> 7, EXPO 2**0.5 argument -> 1.414213, DIVO 1/3 2/3 5 -> .666666; c4-001 TE(ALL) 1 TE(1) -> 4, TE(ALL) TE(ALL) -> 4, MEDIAN+MEDIAN in one expression -> 6. Class c refusals at 85 (compile-only): floating literal 1.5E1 COBOL0900, USAGE FLOAT-LONG COBOL0900, boolean B"1" COBOL0900 + COBOL1627, MEDIAN as a subscript COBOL0900 (1985 IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR5/SR6 and A.2.3 'may not be referenced where an integer operand is required'). cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.25.4 RV1 'the content of the argument-1 having the middle value'; OK §1989:A.2.25.4 RV3 'made according to the rules for simple conditions'; OK §1989:A.2.2 (AR1) 'The value of the arithmetic expression, including operational sign, is used in determining the value of the function'; OK §1989:A.2.3 (GR2) 'Those characteristics of the returned value not otherwise specified for a given function are defined by the implementor'.
